item.title: Body of Hailey Buzbee Found in Perry County, Ohio
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — An attorney for the man charged in Hailey Buzbee’s disappearance says authorities have confirmed her body was recovered in Perry County, Ohio, southeast of Columbus. item.title: Tanya Terry Sworn in as Indianapolis’ First Female Police Chief
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS–Indianapolis has appointed its first female police chief, Tanya Terry, a 27-year veteran of the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department. item.title: Sydney Eskenazi, Real Estate Developer and Philanthropist, Dies at 95
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS–Sidney Eskenazi, a prominent Indianapolis philanthropist and namesake of Eskenazi Hospital, died at the age of 95 over the weekend.
